source.title: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3, Incident Response Recommendations and Considerations for Cybersecurity Risk Management: A CSF 2.0 Community Profile
sections_used: Section 2.1, Fig. 2 'Incident response life cycle model based on CSF 2.0 Functions'
Section 2.1, Table 1 'Previous incident response life cycle model's phases and corresponding CSF 2.0 Functions'
Section 3, Table 2 (Preparation and Lessons Learned) and Table 3 (Incident Response)
source.notes: Rev. 3 models incident response with the six CSF 2.0 Functions. Detect, Respond and Recover are the incident response itself; Govern, Identify and Protect are preparation; continuous improvement is the Improvement Category (ID.IM) of Identify.

phases.name: Preparation
phases.description: Governance, risk understanding and protective measures in place before an incident.

phases.name: Detect
phases.description: Finding and analyzing possible attacks and compromises.

phases.name: Respond
phases.description: Managing, analyzing, communicating about and mitigating a detected incident.

phases.name: Recover
phases.description: Restoring assets and operations affected by the incident.

phases.name: Lessons learned (Improvement)
phases.description: Lessons from every phase are analyzed, prioritized and fed back into all Functions.
